name: Paneer Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 2 large bell peppers, halved and deseeded
½ cup cooked quinoa or rice
1 small onion and 1 tomato, finely chopped
½ tsp each coriander powder and garam masala
steps: Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, cook the onion for 4 minutes, then add the tomato and spices and cook for 4 minutes.
Mix in the paneer, quinoa, coriander and salt.
Fill the pepper halves and bake in a covered dish for 15 minutes, then uncovered for 10 minutes.
note: The quinoa makes this a complete, well-rounded main dish.
